title: The Ten Year Deal
character_consistency_block: 1930s vintage rubber-hose cartoon style, bold black ink outlines, flat desaturated shading, authentic retro film texture. TEMPTER: Anthropomorphic tall slender wolf, charcoal grey pinstripe suit, white collared shirt, muted crimson red necktie, white 3-dart cartoon gloves, sharp jaw, wide sly grin with pointed white teeth, classic black pacman pie-eyes, pointed wolf ears. VICTIM: Anthropomorphic small young pup dog, floppy ears, large expressive pie-eyes, cream sweater with muted red horizontal stripes, denim blue overalls with brass buttons, white cartoon gloves.

lines.text: What if ten years from now, you wake up and completely hate your life?
lines.caps: WHAT IF *TEN YEARS | YOU HATE *YOUR LIFE?
lines.visual_prompt: [CHARACTER CONSISTENCY BLOCK] Dark 1930s study, antique mahogany desk, warm golden oil lamp casting amber light, sliver of crescent moon through arched window. The Wolf leans over the desk with a sharp toothy grin. The small pup sits opposite, looking startled.

lines.text: The wolf slides a golden pen across the mahogany table: 'Sign here, kid. An easy road. No struggle.'
lines.visual_prompt: [CHARACTER CONSISTENCY BLOCK] Close-up on the mahogany desk surface. The Wolf's white gloved hand slides a golden fountain pen and yellowed parchment contract across the desk toward the young pup.

lines.text: The young pup hesitates, clutching his ears in doubt: 'Is there really no catch?'
lines.visual_prompt: [CHARACTER CONSISTENCY BLOCK] Over-the-shoulder shot. The small pup in his red-striped sweater and denim overalls clutches his floppy ears, gazing down at the glowing parchment with worried round pie-eyes.

lines.text: 'None at all,' the wolf whispers with a sly wink. 'Just sign your twenties away.'
lines.visual_prompt: [CHARACTER CONSISTENCY BLOCK] Macro tight close-up on the Wolf's face. Cunning pie-eyes with a devious wink, wide curved grin showing needle-sharp white teeth, warm amber glow on sharp cheek fur.

lines.text: With a trembling paw, the pup signs the parchment... and the room fades to black.
lines.visual_prompt: [CHARACTER CONSISTENCY BLOCK] Extreme close-up of the pup's white gloved hand pressing the ink pen to the signature line. The black ink bleeds across the parchment as an oval iris vignette closes into darkness.

lines.text: Ten years pass in an instant. A cold, lifeless office under buzzing fluorescent lights.
lines.visual_prompt: [CHARACTER CONSISTENCY BLOCK] Cold desaturated slate-blue palette. The older pup sits alone in a drab gray cubicle, slumped over towering piles of paperwork beneath a buzzing fluorescent tube.

lines.text: Three in the morning. Lying awake in bed, bathed in the dead blue glare of a phone.
lines.visual_prompt: [CHARACTER CONSISTENCY BLOCK] Dark monochrome bedroom. Digital clock reads 03:00 AM. Cold cyan smartphone light illuminates the pup's exhausted face, hollow eye bags, and slumped shoulders.

lines.text: In the dusty bathroom mirror, he clutches an old photo of who he used to be.
lines.visual_prompt: [CHARACTER CONSISTENCY BLOCK] Cold desaturated bathroom mirror reflection. The tired older pup stares at himself with a tear running down his cheek, clutching a worn sepia photo of his smiling young self.

lines.text: And suddenly, you are back in that warm room. The contract lies unsigned.
lines.visual_prompt: [CHARACTER CONSISTENCY BLOCK] Return to the warm amber lamp light. The blank contract and golden pen sit untouched on the mahogany desk. The Wolf leans in, watching hungrily.

lines.text: Ten years were just handed back to you. So what will you choose today?
lines.caps: HANDED *BACK TO YOU | WHAT WILL YOU *CHOOSE?
lines.visual_prompt: [CHARACTER CONSISTENCY BLOCK] The young pup pushes the pen away, standing upright with determined pie-eyes. Oval iris transition closes smoothly on the pup's hopeful face.
